The company shows adequate liquidity (current ratio 1.30) and a solid equity base, with equity covering about 39% of assets, which supports balance-sheet resilience. However, leverage is still meaningful (liabilities about 59% of assets) and operating profitability is fairly thin (EBIT margin roughly 4.4%), which limits rating strength and points to the lower end of investment grade.

DECISION: BBB-
